about: After receiving the sacraments of eternal life, the community asks that they may obtain pardon and grace. Saint Venantius’s intercession accompanies this request.

seg.tr: Lord, we have received the sacraments of eternal life. We humbly implore You that, with blessed Venantius, Your martyr, pleading for us, they may obtain pardon and grace for us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: they may obtain pardon and grace for us
who lives and reigns with You
in the unity of the Holy Spirit

ex.w005: The sacraments have been received. They are also the gifts through which pardon and grace are sought later in the prayer.
ex.w008: The community that received the sacraments is now humbly imploring God.
ex.w016: Venantius intercedes for the community while it prays. His intercession accompanies the request for the sacraments to obtain pardon and grace.
ex.w019: “They” refers to the sacraments of eternal life already received. Pardon and grace are the benefits sought through them.
ex.w038: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
